prose: Basis: the Techmeme summary of the report; the New York Times article was not fetched. The NYT reports mounting worries over AI-linked debt: CoreWeave's bond yield has topped 15%, insuring SoftBank debt is getting pricier, and some Oracle debt trades near 80 to 90 cents on the dollar.
The piece asks whether trouble at these three names points to broader problems with the data center build-out - the same weak-links theme the paper raised earlier in the week.
